entries.deferred_fact: A total abstraction from a production InitializedVm to prepared memory, compatibility, VP capacity and initial/default VP state, boot-online policy, component inventory/state, virtual time, external resources, and host-operational state.
entries.removal: Replace the whole-object bridge with component Views owned by destination construction.

entries.deferred_fact: A total abstraction from load's optional SavedState and restore_time arguments plus the full destination VP capacity selected by load to the logical VmSnapshotView, selected VP count, and time policy used by the conditional wrapper contract.
entries.removal: Replace with production Views for decoded SavedState, restore-time input, and VP-selection policy.

entries.deferred_fact: A total abstraction from the SavedState and restore_time arguments of LoadedVm::restore_snapshot_state plus the selected VP count read from its LoadedVm pre-state to VmSnapshotView and restore policy. It must expose only SavedState-owned partition, stable-identity VP, inventory, per-component ComponentSnapshotStateView, and virtual-time state. Prepared memory, compatibility, resources, and snapshot-generation provenance are already represented by or established before the helper's LoadedVm pre-state and must not be invented here.
entries.removal: Replace this bridge with production Views for SavedState units and restore-time inputs. Keep preparation and VP-instantiation contracts outside this TOP.

entries.deferred_fact: A total abstraction from the returned production LoadedVm to memory, preserved destination VP capacity, partition and stable-identity VP state, complete component inventory, per-component split of active component state into snapshot, configuration, and host-runtime parts, pending component snapshot state, virtual time, resources, active VP count, and execution phase.
entries.removal: Replace the representation bridge with component Views and connect them with closed representation invariants and lemmas.

entries.deferred_fact: Downtime compensation of one VP's snapshot state: TSC advanced by the downtime cycles at the saved TSC frequency and the local APIC timer by the corresponding ticks at the saved or destination APIC frequency; every other VP field unchanged. Identity on architectures that do not advance the TSC.
entries.consumer: VmSnapshotView::after_downtime in the LoadedVm::restore_snapshot_state TOP postcondition
entries.removal: Define it from the VP state View once that View exposes TSC and APIC timer state.

entries.deferred_fact: Downtime compensation of partition snapshot state: the backend snapshot clock advanced by the downtime; every other partition field unchanged.
entries.consumer: VmSnapshotView::after_downtime in the LoadedVm::restore_snapshot_state TOP postcondition
entries.removal: Define it from the partition state View once that View exposes the backend snapshot clock.

entries.deferred_fact: Downtime compensation of one live component's snapshot state: the component's advance_time effect (for example the CMOS RTC clock); identity for components that keep the default no-op advance_time.
entries.consumer: VmSnapshotView::after_downtime in the LoadedVm::restore_snapshot_state TOP postcondition
entries.removal: Define it per component from the component snapshot View, together with the StateUnits::advance_time refinement.
